a: Compartmentalized failure: one sick leg degrades capacity instead of sinking the fleet.

q: What are the three moves in this lab?
a: Shed excess at the limiter, eject the sick leg with the breaker, serve degraded on survivors.

q: When is degradation designed vs luck?
a: When it has its own alerts, thresholds, and drills — otherwise it is just a smaller outage.
